class.name: Bobbing2D
class.brief_description: Floats smoothly around its starting position.
class.description: A [Node2D] that moves back and forth around the position it had when entering the scene, following a sine wave. It doesn't move in the editor.

method.name: reset_base_position
method.description: Uses the current position as the new center of the movement.

members.member: Maximum distance from the starting position on each axis, in pixels.
Number of full cycles per second.
Offset of the cycle, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
